newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 1996 growth revised up to 1.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: French 1996 growth revised up to 1.5 percent.

text.p: The French economy expanded by 1.5 percent last year, higher than the previous estimate of 1.3 percent for growth in gross domestic product, the national statistics office INSEE said Tuesday

Economists said the latest figure was largely a technical matter, that GDP figures for the last two quarters of 1996 had not changed and what counted now was whether growth would accelerate this year, the test year for joining a single European currency.
INSEE also released data showing consumer spending flat in March after a fall in February, but economists said this, too, was a reasonably healthy figure when read along with data for January.
